name: DiscordDeck
author: Lexodeus

publish.description: Adds Discord to the Steam menu. Opens Discord or Vesktop (Vencord) installed from Discover without adding it as a non-Steam game.

Changelog:
## 0.3.0 (2026-11-10)

- You can upload files with **+** → **Upload a File**. Discord's file picker used to open where you couldn't see it. Now it shows up on top of Discord, and Discord comes back when you close it. See Uploading files in the README.

### Fixes

- DiscordDeck works with Vesktop 1.6 and newer again. It stayed on "Starting Vesktop…" because Vesktop renamed its window.
